definition: the project's step-chain flow config — DATA, not code (requirements-spec AC-3, flow-control-spec v6 §7). chains maps a WORK TYPE to its step sequence; a task's contract.workType selects it, 'default' applies otherwise; an EMPTY chain = the task runs the lifecycle only (execution tasks — the runner does the work). A task's contract.flow overrides all. The engine reads this file and never overrides it.
template: idea → validate → envision → detailed specs → continue (beginning build / planning); execution tasks run the lifecycle (work-type chains)
